description:
Initialization only (Scarcity-Adjusted Search):
- Initial Order: Sort assigned tasks by (reward / imaging duration) / (1 + ln(1 + legal candidate count)) descending, then smaller task ID.
- Local Improvement: Prioritize missing tasks by candidate scarcity, then reward and ID; enumerate insertion, lower-reward replacement, pairwise reversal, and reinsertion.
- Selection: Return edit selected by feedback attempt; evaluated through runtime.
